content_sections.text: Advt No. किशावि/जैकिप्र/तरुण व्यावसायिक-१/जाहिरात/1119/२०२६ gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MPKV notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 1. Degree in the Agricultural Science branch from a recognised university. 2. Preference will be given to holders of the highest educational qualification and experience. Experience: Preference will be given to holders of the highest educational qualification and experience Other conditions: Must work full time for the scheme / laboratory and cannot take any other job during the appointment Daily work and attendance at the scheme office / laboratory, under the Head, Entomology Department Must obtain a No Objection Certificate from the Head, Entomology Department before applying for any other post while appointed Must carry out scheme work assigned from time to time by the Head, Entomology Department Desirable: Preference to holders of the highest educational qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual; first appointment for 11 months No right or claim to permanent appointment with the Government of Maharashtra or the University Services terminated with 24 hours' notice for negligence, misconduct or unsatisfactory work Undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper required after appointment One month's notice before leaving, or deposit one month's salary if leaving abruptly

content_sections.heading: How Will MPKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview No travelling or other allowance for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format Attested copies of original certificates All original certificates / documents for verification at the interview

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Use of unfair means in the selection will lead to disqualification Advertised posts may not necessarily be filled; all rights regarding recruitment are reserved Dues must be settled before leaving the scheme / laboratory; no claim afterwards When leaving, hand over full charge to other project staff and obtain a No Objection Certificate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional- I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application format attached to the advertisement (page 3 of this PDF)) and send it to Office of the Head, Entomology Department, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, by in person during office hours or by post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month (honorarium).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree in the Agricultural Science branch from a recognised university. Preference will be given to holders of the highest educational qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must work full time for the scheme / laboratory and cannot take any other job during the appointment. Daily work and attendance at the scheme office / laboratory, under the Head, Entomology Department. Must obtain a No Objection Certificate from the Head, Entomology Department before applying for any other post while appointed. Must carry out scheme work assigned from time to time by the Head, Entomology Department.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. No travelling or other allowance for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual; first appointment for 11 months. No right or claim to permanent appointment with the Government of Maharashtra or the University. Services terminated with 24 hours' notice for negligence, misconduct or unsatisfactory work.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Biological Pest Control Laboratory, Entomology Department, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Filled application in the prescribed format; Attested copies of original certificates; All original certificates / documents for verification at the interview.
